stator_defaults.profile: single NACA4 camber — no piecewise linear-exit fraction
stator_defaults.spanwise_inlet: 2-D extruded (constant section) — already matches Kim '2D averaged' preference at geometry level
stator_defaults.downstream_duct: not parameterized; vane sits in AFTER_MRF_MM band only

linear_exit_30pct.kim: best when meridional length at 0° (linear exit) = 30% of total; worst at 70%
linear_exit_30pct.stator_today: NACA4 continuous camber (camber_pos=0.4); no explicit linear-exit fraction param
linear_exit_30pct.action: add linear_exit_frac (default 0.30) building a cambered LE + flat TE plate/NACA hybrid

2d_averaged_inlet.kim: 2-D vane with span-averaged inlet angle beats 3-D spanwise angles
2d_averaged_inlet.stator_today: already 2-D extruded constant section; stagger_deg single value (default 50°)
2d_averaged_inlet.action: keep 2-D; document that Kim prefers average inlet over 3-D twist; optional inlet_angle override separate from stagger

duct_after_025D.kim: ~0.25 Ds vaneless duct after short vanes so recovered pressure sticks
duct_after_025D.stator_today: no post-vane duct length param; domain/casing is separate
duct_after_025D.action: document as rig/domain note; optional after_stator_duct_D frac for CFD case builder (not in stator solid)

patents.US8333559B2: Active — distinctive tip lean/stacking-line reverse curve + tip camber/chord increase. NOT the 30% linear-exit rule. Avoid shipping that tip geometry.
patents.generic_30pct_linear_exit: No live patent found that claims '30% linear exit on short OGV' as such (search not exhaustive). Not legal advice.

size_caveat: Kim fan hub ratio 0.41, ~880 rpm industrial wall fan — use rules not absolute angles
